items.title: Category × difficulty matrix
items.description: Narrow the pool to animals for kids or hard actions for adults without rebuilding a list.

items.description: Drawn words stay out until you reset the round history, so long sessions never stall on duplicates.

items.title: Custom word lists

how_to_use.name: How to use
how_to_use.label: Three steps
how_to_use.title: From zero to first round in seconds
how_to_use.description: This Pictionary word generator needs no cards, no apps, and no sign-up.

items.title: Set the pool
items.description: Choose a category and difficulty, or paste your own word list.

items.title: Draw the words
items.description: Draw 1, 3, 5, or 10 words at once — the drawer sees only their own word.

items.title: Start the timer
items.description: Pick 30, 60, or 90 seconds and let the team guess before time runs out.

items.title: Keep score
items.description: Tap +1 for the guessing team and reset scores between games.

items.title: Is this Pictionary word generator free?
items.description: Yes — every word, filter, the timer, and the scoreboard are free with no sign-up.

items.title: How many words are in the pool?
items.description: The Pictionary word generator ships with 450 curated words across 10 categories and 3 difficulty levels, plus any custom words you paste in.

items.title: Can I use my own words?
items.description: Yes. Enable your own word list and paste up to 300 words — one per line or separated by commas.

items.title: What timer should I use?
items.description: 60 seconds is the classic pace. Use 30 seconds for competitive groups and 90 seconds for kids.

items.title: Does it work for Charades or Catchphrase too?
items.description: Yes — the same words work for any drawing or guessing game that needs random prompts.

items.title: Is it okay for kids?
items.description: Yes. Every word in the pool is family-friendly; choose Easy for younger players.
